text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Thursday.
Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- A seminar on restarting credit in Angola began on Wednesday. The seminar was organised by the National Bank and will discuss encouraging businesses to give credit to customers.
- The head of the Angolan Army in Benguela, Brigadier Joao Kitekulo, defended his decision to keep his troops on a combat footing saying," this is only to prevent a return to war".
